title: Phone macro glide, twin phones, icon to wordmark
summary: One phone rises to fill a flat acid-lime frame, then the camera glides in macro over its balance chart and tab bar, slides up the screen on a tilted low angle, pulls back to two phones, and closes on the app icon and a lowercase wordmark.
use_when: A mobile finance or tracking app with one strong home screen (balance + chart + tab bar)
Silent social or landing-page loop where the product UI is the whole story
A loud single-colour brand background that can carry the frame without type
Teaser before launch: no copy lines, only the screen, the icon and the name

look.type_style: UI type only (small grotesk inside the phone, balance figure bold); close: lowercase grotesk wordmark, regular weight, about 3 % of frame height, centred

sfx.event: phone rises to fill the frame
phone swings out and the screen bottom swings in
twin phones slide up into frame

structure.shot: one phone, small (about 35 % H) and slightly turned, centred on flat lime; home screen with balance, chart, tab bar
structure.camera: push-in 0.35 -> 1.0 of frame-filling phone in 15 fr, ending low so the phone's bottom crops
structure.motion: phone scale + straighten on springs.cameraIn 15 fr (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: upper half of the phone: status bar, balance figure, four tabs, red down day line, jagged pink line chart
structure.camera: drift: phone width +4 % over 60 fr, slow roll 0 -> 2 deg, slight rise
structure.motion: phone holds; continuous scale creep easings.inOutSine 60 fr

structure.shot: closer on the balance and chart; phone pushed off the left edge so only its right two-thirds remain
structure.camera: push-in 1.0 -> 1.35 over 68 fr with a pan left (phone x 50 % -> 30 % of frame) and roll back to about -3 deg
structure.motion: camera on easings.inOutSine 68 fr; nothing moves inside the screen

structure.shot: phone swings up and out the top; its lower screen (card stack with badge, account card, tab bar) swings in from the top and settles mid-frame
structure.camera: whip tilt down the device: top half exits by 5.00, lower half settles 5.50 (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: device rotate + translate on springs.heavy about 20 fr (overshoot not measurable); 5.50-6.27 slow drift down-left 4 %

structure.shot: macro on the tab bar: active first tab icon and label large, unread dot on the fourth tab; the frame travels along the tabs to the last one
structure.camera: push-in 1.0 -> 2.2 in 8 fr (±0.25 s), then dolly right across the tabs about 20 px/fr @1920 from 7.00 to 8.27
structure.motion: zoom on springs.cameraIn, then the lateral dolly on easings.inOutSine 38 fr

structure.shot: pulled back: whole lower screen of the phone with the account card, card stack and tab bar, phone bottom edge visible
structure.camera: pull-out 2.2 -> 1.0 in 8 fr (±0.25 s), then a small rise 9.00

structure.shot: low angle on the phone's bottom edge (port, speaker holes), screen leaned far back; camera climbs up the screen past the tab bar, cards and buying power to the chart
structure.camera: tilt-plane lean about 60 deg with depth of field; dolly up the screen about 18 px/fr @1920, zoom +55 %/s at 9-11 s then +40 %/s
structure.motion: camera on easings.linear 105 fr; near edge sharp, far UI blurred; slight roll 0 -> 2 deg

structure.shot: same tilted screen reaching the top: chart, then the balance, tabs and status bar with the phone's top edge against lime
structure.camera: dolly continues up but decelerates: about 11 px/fr at 13 s, 5 px/fr at 14.5 s; roll -2 deg
structure.motion: easings.outQuint 70 fr into the top edge; the top edge stops about 30 % below the frame top

structure.shot: two phones, upright, offset: lower-left shows the top of the home screen, upper-right shows the lower screen with cards and tab bar
structure.camera: static frame; phones drift up slowly about 1 px/fr
structure.motion: both phones slide up from below the frame 15.07 -> 15.50 on springs.ui 13 fr (±0.25 s), staggered: right phone leads; then easings.linear drift

structure.shot: both phones lean back and exit: left one flies up and off the top-left, right one drops off the bottom
structure.motion: tilt then exit on easings.inExpo 15 fr (±0.25 s), opposite directions

structure.shot: the app icon, small white rounded square with the brand mark, centred on lime with a soft shadow
structure.motion: icon present in its first cell (entrance not measurable at 0.25 s); holds 45 fr

structure.shot: the icon is replaced by the lowercase wordmark, one word, small, centred, black on lime
structure.motion: swap in one cell (±0.25 s); holds 87 fr to the end

params.brand: brand.json: bg = the loud flat colour (lime here), accent for the active tab and icon mark, fg for UI type
params.content.balance: headline figure on the home screen
params.content.dayChange: small coloured change line under the tabs
params.content.chart: values for the jagged line chart (about 40 points, falling day)
params.content.subFigure: secondary figure in the account card
params.content.card: notification card: label, 2-line message, badge count
params.content.tabs: 5 tab labels + icons, one active, one with an unread dot
params.content.icon: app icon image or mark for the close

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). No copy at all: the screen, the icon and the name carry the film. The 9.23 shot needs a 3D phone model (bottom edge, port, speaker holes) leaned back with depth of field; PhoneFrame + TiltPlane only covers the screen. Chart is static (no draw-on), so chart-draw is not tagged. Proposed term: icon-wordmark-swap (rows 11-12). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured: the reference is silent.
